title: gtm-cs 1:1 prep - Max Evans (Tiger Retail)
content:
Context:
- 30-min weekly 1:1 with Max (AE) to align on Tiger Retail (top-10 ARR) renewal prep and pilot expansion. Renewal window: Jul 2026 (Q3).
- Current footprint: Hosted API + one Dedicated pool for peak traffic (Black Friday). Monthly spend: ~$42k. Usage growing ~12% MoM.
- Recent issues: 2026-02-24 latency spike (~2s p95) during heavy traffic window; SRE applied temporary throttles. Customer concerned about tail latency for checkout personalization flows.

Goals for this 1:1:
1) Align on renewal ask and expansion targets (aim: +30% committed capacity, introduce Optimize add-on).
2) Confirm technical action plan for tail latency (SRE tasks + timeline).
3) Plan executive sponsor outreach and value quantification (metrics to show).
4) Decide on next customer-facing demo (quantization vs. batching tradeoffs).

Agenda (30 min):
- 0-5 min: Quick status + wins (usage trend, positive feedback from merchandising team).
- 5-12 min: Incident recap + proposed mitigation (what we fixed, what remains).
- 12-20 min: Renewal strategy (pricing bands, commitment tiers, discounting guardrails).
- 20-27 min: Pilot expansion ask + demo plan.
- 27-30 min: Action items + owners.

Key talking points / notes:
- Emphasize predictable economics: propose Dedicated capacity baseline + Optimize recommendation to cut per-token cost by ~18% for their workload.
- For latency: explain smart routing + fallback to smaller model variants during spikes; present SLOs we can commit to with Dedicated + Optimize config.
- Risk: customer will push for 20% discount if we ask for 36% committed uplift. Keep negotiation ladder: 15% off at 20% uplift, 10% off at 30% uplift with 12-month commit.
- Exec outreach: ask Max to coordinate a brief with Tiger Retail CTO and procurement — suggest 30-min call with customer success director and AE.

Technical backlog (for SRE/serving-runtime):
- Task A: Root cause analysis of 2026-02-24 p95 latency (log correlation + KV cache hit-rate). Owner: SRE (Avery). ETA: 2026-03-18.
- Task B: Canary autoscaling policy tweak for Dedicated pool (reduce scale-down aggressiveness). Owner: Infra (Rohit). ETA: 2026-03-22.
- Task C: Performance runbook + customer-facing one-pager about batching/quantization tradeoffs. Owner: Eng Solutions (Me). ETA: 2026-03-25.

Metrics to use in renewal deck:
- Monthly active requests, 95/99 latencies pre/post changes, cost per 1M tokens (current vs projected with Optimize), purchases conversion delta from personalization tests (if available).

Proposed asks of Max for this week:
- Get confirmed date for CTO touchpoint (by 2026-03-15).
- Share procurement timeline and any constraint on procurement (by 2026-03-18).
- Approve customer for a short pilot of Optimize on a subset of routes (2-week A/B).

Draft action items (to capture in follow-up email):
- Leah: Prepare 1-page renewal options (3 tiers + recommended path) and send to Max by 2026-03-13.
- Max: Confirm CTO availability and procurement timeline by 2026-03-15.
- Avery: Deliver RCA summary and initial mitigation proposals by 2026-03-18.
- Rohit: Share proposed autoscaling policy change and impact analysis by 2026-03-22.
- Leah/AE: Schedule 30-min exec call (target week of 2026-03-22).

Notes to self / talking phrasing:
- "We want to make capacity predictable for you as you scale seasonal traffic — proposing a hybrid: baseline Dedicated with burst capacity and Optimize to lower per-token costs."
- "We take tail latency seriously — here's our mitigation plan and the metrics we'll commit to monitor together."
- Keep discounting conservative; prioritize getting contractual commitment length over deep short-term discounts.

Follow-up: send recap + action items right after 1:1. Use simple subject: 'Recap & next steps — 1:1 Max / Tiger Retail (Mar 11)'.

Misc / scratch:
- Possible execs: CTO = Mark Lim; procurement lead = Sofia Alvarez.
- Link to internal playbook for renewals: confluence:tiger-renewal-playbook-2025 (check for updated pricing bands).

End of notes.
